title: Trust and Obey
alsoKnownAs: When We Walk with the Lord
description: Trust and Obey in Tonic Solfa to TRUST AND OBEY: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the five verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: John H. Sammis wrote the words, first published in 1887. The tune, TRUST AND OBEY, is by Daniel Brink Towner (1887).
underlay: When we walk with the Lord in the light of His Word, What a glo-ry He sheds on our way! While we do His good will, He a-bides with us still, And with all who will trust and o-bey. Trust and o-bey, for there’s no oth-er way To be hap-py in Je-sus, but to trust and o-bey.

lines: When we walk with the Lord in the light of His Word,
What a glory He sheds on our way!
While we do His good will, He abides with us still,
And with all who will trust and obey.

verses.label: Refrain
lines: Trust and obey, for there’s no other way
To be happy in Jesus, but to trust and obey.
Not a shadow can rise, not a cloud in the skies,
But His smile quickly drives it away;
Not a doubt or a fear, not a sigh or a tear,
Can abide while we trust and obey.
Not a burden we bear, not a sorrow we share,
But our toil He doth richly repay;
Not a grief or a loss, not a frown or a cross,
But is blessed if we trust and obey.
But we never can prove the delights of His love
Until all on the altar we lay;
For the favor He shows, for the joy He bestows,
Are for them who will trust and obey.
Then in fellowship sweet we will sit at His feet,
Or we’ll walk by His side in the way;
What He says we will do, where He sends we will go;
Never fear, only trust and obey.
